items.title: Widerspruch gegen Beitragsbescheid
items.quote: Den Widerspruch können Sie binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Musterquell Krankenkasse, Am Brunnenhof 2, 35390 Mustergießen.
items.computation: Letter dated 18.11.2026 (Wednesday), posted same day. Letter states: 'Als bekannt gegeben gilt der Bescheid am vierten Tag nach seiner Aufgabe zur Post.' Counting 4 days from 18.11.2026 (day of posting not counted as day 1 of the 4-day count, per analogous § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X methodology): 19.11 (Thu) = day 1, 20.11 (Fri) = day 2, 21.11 (Sat) = day 3, 22.11 (Sun) = day 4. Since the 4th day (22.11.2026) falls on a Sunday, under the standard rule applied to such delivery fictions (analogous to § 37 Abs. 2 Satz 3 SGB X), deemed delivery (Bekanntgabe) shifts to the next business day: Monday 23.11.2026. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist then runs under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB: the day of Bekanntgabe (23.11.2026) is not counted (§187(1)); the period ends on the day of the following month that corresponds by number to the day of the triggering event, i.e. 23.12.2026. 23.12.2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in NRW, so no further shift under § 193 BGB is needed. The objection must reach the Krankenkasse by this date.

items.title: First direct debit of increased contribution (318.46 €)
items.quote: Wir buchen den Beitrag weiterhin zum 15. des Folgemonats ab.
items.computation: The increased monthly contribution of 318.46 € applies from 01.01.2027. The letter states contributions are debited on the 15th of the month following the contribution month ('zum 15. des Folgemonats'). The first month at the new rate is January 2027, so the first debit of the new amount occurs on 15.02.2027 (a Monday, no weekend/holiday adjustment needed).

warnings: The letter's stated delivery fiction ('am vierten Tag nach seiner Aufgabe zur Post') differs from the usual statutory 3-day rule under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X; this computation follows the letter's own wording, but the person should double-check this against the Kasse's actual Satzung if the exact deadline matters.
The letter does not state the previous (pre-increase) monthly contribution amount for comparison, only the new amount of 318,46 €.
